text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOOOOOO~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wah-wah-wah-wah... At this rate,
Opera O-san is going to... eeek~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My divination just revealed it!
An unprecedented, earth-shattering, full-course, ultra-colossal calamity is about to strike Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Anyway, we have to find Opera O-san immediately
and get her to evacuate to safety...! We can't just stand around here~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you two have arrived at just the right moment!
I was precisely about to commence rehearsal for my newest opera!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-Please listen to me, Opera O-san!
Disaster is heading your way! Please evacuate to somewhere safe immediately~...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Disaster? Ha-ha-ha! What calamity could possibly dare to threaten I, TM Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-It's totally... like, KABOOM, and then SWOOSH, and then out cold, u-um...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In short, it's utter doom, supreme catastrophe, and ultimate bad karma! Plus optional snowstorms, lightning, and massive volcanic eruptions—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! Have no fear!
Such trifles will merely serve as splendid special effects to embellish my stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come now, banish those gloomy expressions.
Step upon my stage. With my brilliance, I shall restore your radiant smiles—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeees... Ah, how magnificent... A warm light is soothing this frightened heart of mine~—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, n-n-no! That's not right! Fueeeh...
How can we save Opera O-san~...!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—No need to worry! I've just divined the answer!
The method to rescue Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To fight evil with evil, quite simply...
Doto-san, you must become a demon!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueeeh!? A-A demon, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By becoming a demon far scarier than the looming calamity to shock her, we'll force her to evacuate from this spot!
Can you do it, Doto-san!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—I-I'll do it! If it can save Opera O-san,
I'll do whatever it takes!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, I shall now channel a demon into Doto-san! Hold a bundle of incense in both hands, hold a stick of butter and a rice cracker in your mouth—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haaah~ Dracula Caterpillar Specter... On-on-carrot, fluffy fried rice...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
............ Pshuuu~...!
Devil Installation completed... poko!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My, whatever is the matter, Doto?
Don't be shy, come over here—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I-I am not Doto! Poko!
I am the specter who just possessed this maiden...
I mean, the Demon Tanuki, poko!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! Well now, isn't this an extraordinarily adorable little tanuki!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If you don't leave here right away, I'll curse you~...!
A tanuki tail will sprout on you, and you'll turn into a tea kettle~...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a metamorphosis tale, is it!
Ha-ha-ha! That sounds most intriguing as well!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-It's seriously dangerous! I've even prepared heaps of much more terrible catastrophes!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Even this maiden might not be able to gaze upon your beautiful figure anymore!
S-She'll surely... be utterly devastated!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Oho. Little tanuki, by the sound of your words, can you sense Doto's anxiety?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Of course! I'm so anxious, so worried that if you don't run away quickly, my chest is gonna... *sniff*, burst into pieces~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Ha-ha-ha! Understood!
Indeed, should any misfortune befall me, a veil of darkness would fall upon the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh!? T-Then, does that mean...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I shall heed your advice and take my exit here.
Farewell, adieu!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-We did ittt~!!
We managed to save Opera O-san safely...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nunu? Could that mean... perhaps Opera O-san didn't care about the demon at all...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehe... A-Anyway, as long as Opera O-san is safe, I'm so glad...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Mumu!? Come to think of it, where Trainer-san is standing right now, wasn't that the exact spot Opera O-san was standing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then. A bicycle zooms violently through a puddle right next to me—

text_block_list.name: ドトウ&フクキタル
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Drenched in muddy water and showered with pitying gazes, I realized what misfortune truly meant.
